req.title: Return arbitrary status code
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /status/<code> with an HTTP response bearing the requested status code, for codes 100 through 599.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /status/<code> returns exactly the requested HTTP status code for codes 100-599. To achieve high mutation kill rate: (1) EP tests cover representative codes from each class (2xx, 4xx, 5xx); (2) BVA tests probe the exact boundaries 100, 101, 598, 599 and the off-by-one values 99 and 600; (3) NEG tests verify that invalid/out-of-range codes are rejected with 400; (4) DT tests cover special codes with known side-effects (301 redirect header, 418 teapot body); (5) STC tests verify that multiple HTTP methods (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) also work. Every assertion uses exact equality to catch operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_status_406_json_body
preconditions: code 406 is in code_map with JSON body
trace: R-HTTPBIN-014: special code 406 must return JSON body with message field
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_status_406_json_body():
    r = client.get('/status/406')
    assert r.status_code == 406
    assert r.content_type == 'application/json'
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert 'message' in body
    assert body['message'] == 'Client did not request a supported media type.'
